title: add downgrade-guard, schema-migration hooks, and backup/restore hardening for private-installer
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private require safe upgrades and rollbacks across air-gapped and VPC installs. This PR adds a downgrade guard, stronger version pinning, idempotent backup/restore flows, and explicit schema migration hooks to the private-installer toolchain. It also hardens the Postgres migration path used by the control plane so rollbacks do not leave clusters in an unrecoverable state.

What this PR does (high level):
- Add a downgrade guard check that prevents applying control-plane schema migrations when target version is older than the current installed version unless --force-downgrade is provided and an explicit backup snapshot exists.
- Introduce version pinning for helm charts and terraform modules inside the installer manifests; new installer config exposes pinned_versions.* keys.
- Implement pre/post migration hooks (scripts) that run on the control-plane node: safe-migrate-precheck.sh and safe-migrate-postcheck.sh. These verify disk space, active connections, and KV cache snapshot consistency.
- Make backup/restore idempotent: restore is now transactional (create temp schema, apply data, swap schemas) to avoid partial restores when interrupted.
- Add explicit DB migration rollback scripts for the last 3 migration steps and a migration-introspection command for operators to see pending/failed migrations.
- Add automated smoke tests and CI job that runs a local Helm/Terraform upgrade -> migrate -> downgrade scenario against a dev Postgres instance.
- Update docs and examples for private-installer upgrade strategy and runbook.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add downgrade guard logic and flags
- [x] Implement pre/post migration hooks and runbook
- [x] Make backup/restore transactional
- [x] Add migration rollback helpers
- [x] Add CI smoke job and tests
- [x] Documentation updates

Related: Linear ENG-2193, ENG-2401; Support ticket SUP-4432 referenced for customer repro. See design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2193/private-installer-downgrade-guard-design (internal).

Merge notes: squash-merged to main. Operators should follow runbook in docs/private-installer/upgrade.md; the installer will refuse unsafe downgrades by default.
